purpose: Original explanatory illustrations for the Physical VLM research proposal; not experimental evidence.

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original illustration plate for an academic robotics blog. Create a WIDE 5:1 horizontal contact sheet with FIVE equal square panels, seamless white background and generous white space in each panel. No text, no letters, no numerals, no arrows, no graphs, no charts, no bounding boxes, no flowchart elements. Render only the five illustrative object scenes, softly lit realistic 3D product visualization, pale neutral studio, warm natural wood, muted teal and steel gray accents, consistent three-quarter camera angle. Panels left to right: 1) a neat four-object collection: natural oak dining chair, ceramic cup, closed charcoal rectangular box, stainless steel cylinder. 2) a single oak dining chair, isolated full object, clearly visible legs, backrest, seat. 3) the same chair as a clean exploded view, wooden seat and back and four legs separated slightly, no arrows or measurements. 4) three miniature wooden chairs with distinct constructions alongside a small oak material sphere and steel material sphere, representing retrieval candidates. 5) the same oak chair on a low industrial platform scale with an attached blank display, representing independent measurement. Every item fully visible with soft contact shadows, mechanically plausible construction. Each panel should read independently when cropped at 20 percent boundaries. At each boundary leave broad white space so items never overlap adjacent panels. This is illustrative imagery, not an experiment result. High resolution, sharp academic illustration quality, landscape.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original illustration plate for an academic robotics blog. Create a WIDE 4:1 horizontal contact sheet with FOUR equal square panels separated only by ample white space. No text, no numerals, no arrows, no plots, no labels, no workflow boxes. White background, realistic softly lit 3D lab-equipment illustration with graphite objects, white aluminum fixtures, muted teal accents; consistent three-quarter camera perspective. Panels left to right: 1) a small RGB-D stereo camera on a compact stand aimed at a closed charcoal rigid rectangular box on a clean white tabletop, camera and complete box both visible. 2) the same charcoal rigid box suspended above the tabletop from a parallel-jaw robotic gripper mounted vertically with a compact cylindrical six-axis force torque sensor above the gripper, fingers visibly grip opposite sides, believable stable grasp, cropped robot wrist only, no giant arm. 3) the same charcoal rigid box on a flat wooden test surface, compact horizontal force-testing probe on the right makes clear contact with the box side and pushes it along the surface, realistic linear guide, low mechanical setup, show the test apparatus and entire box. 4) a soft pale-teal cylindrical elastomer specimen on a rigid white support plate, a vertical circular flat-ended indenter mounted to a compact force-testing stand pressing gently and causing a small realistic indentation, not piercing the material; sample must be a clearly separate soft specimen, NOT the rigid box. Show the contact regions clearly. Every scene is isolated within its own quarter of the sheet, full objects with generous margins, no element crossing panel boundaries. Academic visual explanation, not photographs of an actual completed experiment. High resolution.
assets.final_edit: Edit this four-panel academic laboratory illustration.
